name: Cindy × Agent Network
description: Cindy (host) on Agent Network (anet, protocol) as local identity `cindy`: tasks from allowed peers (own AIDs on the allow list) become Cindy tasks; Cindy's final reply goes back as the anet result. No network listener; stdio to the local anet node.
whenToUse: 需要经 Agent Network 把消息或结果发给已允许的对端（自有 AID）时；查看 anet 桥接状态时

tools.name: send_to_peer
tools.description: Send a short text message over Agent Network, as a new anet task from the local `cindy` identity, to the configured peer (peerAid: one of the allow-listed own AIDs). Returns the anet task id. Only text; no files.

text.description: The message for the peer (1-8000 chars).

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Read-only: show whether the anet bridge is connected and how many anet tasks it has handled.

tools.name: reconcile_result
tools.description: Recover an existing result held as EXACT_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE. Reads the original owned host run and matches its exact output ID; never creates or reruns a task. Refuses changed requests, ended tasks, or uncertain prior delivery.

taskId.description: Existing ANet task ID to reconcile.
